format: DanceFlow Studio/Custom competitions, safe operational cutoff for heats committed to the floor
requirement: Classify every floor heat as frozen (staging, active, complete, locked or certified, evidence present, round past scoring), bypassed, confirm-required (commit window or checked-in entries) or movable; a standard grant moves only movable heats; confirm-required heats need a higher grant plus an acknowledgment bound to the preview checksum. Defaults (window of two heats and twenty minutes, pull-forward three, quick-change gap one) are DanceFlow defaults, not body rules.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future classifier inside the apply RPC (database) mirrored by a pure app helper for the preview.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. Called and staged are the same status (staging) in the current vocabulary; ballots are accepted by round state, so unstarted must also be proven by absence of evidence under row locks.
